\documentclass[
  UTF8,
  $if(fontsize)$$fontsize$$else$11pt$endif$,
  aspectratio=$if(aspectratio)$$aspectratio$$else$169$endif$
]{ctexbeamer}

\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{booktabs,longtable,array}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{listings}

\usetheme{$if(theme)$$theme$$else$Warsaw$endif$}
$if(colortheme)$
\usecolortheme{$colortheme$}
$endif$

\definecolor{tutorialaccent}{RGB}{$if(accent-color)$$accent-color$$else$15, 102, 157$endif$}
\setbeamercolor{structure}{fg=tutorialaccent}
\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}
\setbeamertemplate{headline}{}

\providecommand{\tightlist}{%
  \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}
\providecommand{\pandocbounded}[1]{#1}

$if(title)$

$endif$
$if(subtitle)$

$endif$
$if(author)$

$endif$
$if(institute)$

$endif$
$if(date)$

$else$
\date{}
$endif$

$for(header-includes)$
$header-includes$
$endfor$

\begin{document}

$if(title-page)$

  \titlepage
\end{frame}
$endif$

$for(include-before)$

$endfor$

$body$

$for(include-after)$

$endfor$

\end{document}
